verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a legal-services SaaS platform, but the evidence shows no assistant users can hand tasks to. The only AI mention is a narrow AI-powered meeting-minutes generator, which is an adjacent feature rather than a general assistant. Delegation otherwise goes to human specialists, attorneys and business managers, and the llms.txt file only guides external AI crawlers, so none of these count toward this story.
